about.hero.title: Why Receipters?
about.hero.subtitle: Welcome to Receipters – The Future of Receipts
about.hero.description: In a world where cluttered drawers and lost receipts are still common, Receipters brings simplicity, security, and smart technology to the way receipts are handled. Our mission is to eliminate paper waste, streamline expense tracking, and empower users with secure, real-time access to their transactions—anytime, anywhere.
about.values.subtitle: Our Core Values
about.values.title: What Drives Receipters
about.values.description: We believe in building a digital future where every receipt is more than a record—it's a resource. Our values guide how we create, connect, and innovate for businesses and individuals alike.
about.values.simplicity.title: Simplicity
about.values.simplicity.description: We keep it easy for anyone to use Receipters, no matter their tech skills.
about.values.efficiency.title: Efficiency
about.values.efficiency.description: No more lost receipts or manual entries—just seamless automation.
about.values.security.title: Security
about.values.security.description: We protect your data with industry-grade encryption and privacy-first design.
about.values.sustainability.title: Sustainability
about.values.sustainability.description: Helping the world go paperless—because the environment matters.
about.problem.title: Solving a Global Problem
about.problem.description1: Paper receipts are expensive, wasteful, and inconvenient. Receipters replaces them with smart, digital alternatives—cutting costs, reducing environmental waste, and improving customer experience.
about.problem.description2: Our dual model—Software-as-a-Product (SaaP) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS)—serves both vendors and end-users, delivering security, accessibility, and efficiency across the board.
about.vision.title: Our Vision
about.vision.description: To become the global standard for digital receipting—where receipts aren’t just stored, but transformed into smart tools for tracking, analyzing, and improving financial well-being.
about.story.title: Our Story
about.story.description: Receipters was born out of necessity: a modern solution to outdated, wasteful practices. From simplifying returns to preparing taxes or reducing fraud, Receipters transforms each receipt into meaningful data—for consumers and businesses alike.
about.team.title: Meet the Team
about.team.description: A passionate, experienced team of engineers, strategists, and technologists shaping the future of digital receipts.

landing.howItWorks.subtitle: This is how it works
landing.howItWorks.title: Snap, scan, and relax—let Receipters do the heavy lifting!
landing.howItWorks.step1.title: Effortless Receipt Scanning
landing.howItWorks.step1.description: Our advanced AI technology automatically scans, reads, and categorizes your receipts with unmatched accuracy, saving you time and reducing errors. Simply snap a photo, and let Receipters handle the rest.
landing.howItWorks.step2.title: Real-Time Financial Insights
landing.howItWorks.step2.description: Get a comprehensive view of your spending in real-time. Whether you’re tracking daily expenses or managing a company budget, our intuitive dashboard offers powerful insights to help you make better financial decisions.
landing.howItWorks.step3.title: Seamless Integration with Financial Tools
landing.howItWorks.step3.description: Easily connect Receipters to your bank accounts, credit cards, and other financial tools. Keep all your financial data in one place, simplifying the way you manage and monitor your expenses.
landing.testimonials.subtitle: Testimonials
landing.testimonials.title: We believe Receipters is the best tool out there. But, listen to our happy clients.
landing.testimonials.quote: “As a small business owner, I can’t imagine managing my finances without Receipters. It’s the best tool out there for seamless expense tracking.”
